messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported the console audit CSV export is missing the `actor` column for some rows after a KMS key rotation. They pasted a snippet of the CSV and the header looks fine but the actor cells are empty for ~8% of events.

ashok: ugh. do we know if those events were created during the rotation window or if they reference a service principal? can you paste the CSV header + one offending row?

maria: header: `timestamp,event_type,resource,actor_id,actor_email,actor_role,details`
row: `2026-03-18T15:12:03Z,api_key.update,projects/123, , ,service-account, key rotated`

kevin: this smells like a downstream marshaling bug when we sign/unwrap with the rotated key — actor fields are in the event payload but our export pipeline may drop them if KMS decryption fails silently.

olivia: are we sure it's KMS and not RBAC? if the user who triggered export doesn't have 'audit_viewer' on that resource we intentionally blank some PII. Could be a preflight permission check regression.

maria: customer claims the same actor was visible in the console viewer but not in CSV download. console UI shows full actor. CSV missing.

ashok: that rules out RBAC masking then. UI and CSV use different backends: UI hits the private-control-plane + preview unmask endpoint, CSV is generated by the export service reading the audit store and streaming to S3. different codepaths.

kevin: quick debug idea: run an export locally for the same time window with `--raw` and `--schema-version` flags to see what's in the stored proto before streaming. if the proto has actor fields, it's export-time. if not, ingestion.

maria: i tried a quick `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/tmp/abc.csv -` and grepped, the actor id column is empty but the raw event proto in the logs (search by event_id) has actor set. so it's export-time.

olivia: okay — then two likely culprits: (1) streaming CSV serializer drops fields when encountering a decryption error and doesn't fail the job, or (2) pagination/truncation logic concatenates partial buffers and rewrites CSV headers leading to column shuffling.

kevin: here's a minimal repro I ran locally that shows the serializer path:```python
# pseudo
for proto in stream_protos(query):
    try:
        event = decrypt_proto(proto, kms_key)
    except KMSDecryptError:
        log.warn('decrypt failed, continuing')
        event = sanitize_for_partial_export(proto)
    writer.write_csv_row(event)
```
If `sanitize_for_partial_export` returns a map without `actor_*`, that would explain blanks.

ashok: suggests we should change behavior: if decryption fails for an event, mark the row with `<<ENCRYPTION_ERROR>>` in the `details` column and keep actor columns empty but add `export_error` column, and ensure job returns non-200 status to prevent silent bad downloads.

maria: +1 on explicit error marker. customer expects fidelity and clear failure semantics, not silent omissions.

olivia: also propose adding `schema_version` and `exported_by` (user id) into CSV footer/metadata so customers can validate. and add a preflight check endpoint `GET /v1/audit-exports/preview` that responds with sample rows and a small validation: `ok|partial|fail` with reason codes. this would surface permission/kms issues before large export runs.

kevin: agree on preflight. we should also add an `export_preview` RBAC permission so product teams can expose preview without granting full export rights. mapping: `role:audit_reader` -> allow preview, `role:audit_exporter` -> full export.

sec-bot: deploy scheduled — export-service v2.3.7 will be rolled to prod tomorrow 09:00 UTC. watch: #incidents if regressions.

maria: action items: 1) kevin - add explicit `export_error` column + non-200 on export job failure (ETA 2d). 2) ashok - add preflight preview endpoint + `export_preview` permission (ETA 3d). 3) olivia - update console UX to call preview when user clicks "Export" and show validation results (ETA 4d). 4) ops - gate v2.3.7 rollout behind feature flag for audit export.

ashok: i'll also add an integration test that rotates a test KMS key mid-window and asserts exports either fail or include `<<ENCRYPTION_ERROR>>`.

kevin: i'll open a PR with the serializer change and tests. linking in the thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/export-service/pull/451

maria: thanks everyone — i'll follow up with the customer and share the preview endpoint when available.

olivia: and let's capture this in the audit export runbook (postmortem section) so support knows how to respond.

kevin: noted. will add changelog entry and telemetry to count `export_error` rows so we can alert on >0.1% rate.

maria: closing loop: customer is okay with preview ETA, wants notification when fixed. i'll update ticket.
_meta: generated: security slack thread about audit export CSV missing actor fields after KMS rotation; contains short messages, code snippet, action items
